self.what: A note app for independent researchers that keeps every note as plain text.
self.makes: Plain-text notes that sync between a researcher's devices.

parts.name: The app
parts.what: The editor people write their notes in.

parts.name: Sync service
parts.what: Keeps notes the same on every device.

not: the storage that holds the synced notes

entities.name: Independent researchers
entities.matters: They are who it is for: if they stop writing in it, nothing else counts.

signals.what: Daily visits from the people it serves.
How many notes people still keep after a year.

entities.name: Acme Storage
entities.matters: Sync runs on it, so its prices and its outages are ours.

signals.what: Their storage prices, which set what sync costs.

entities.name: Inkwell Plugins
entities.matters: The plugins people ask for most; a change to the plugin interface breaks them first.

signals.what: New plugin releases and what they need from the interface.

entities.name: Ledgerpad
entities.matters: The tool researchers leave for, or come from.

signals.what: Features it ships that people ask Quillmark for.

entities.name: Open Notes Format group
entities.matters: The format is shaped together; a draft that changes it changes the app.

entities.name: Data protection regulators
entities.matters: Their rules decide how synced notes may be kept.

signals.what: Changes to the rules for personal data where its users live.

entities.name: Local libraries
entities.matters: They host the workshops that bring new writers.

entities.name: Small Press Fair
entities.matters: It sponsors the yearly meetup, where most new plugin writers first come.

signals.what: The date of the next meetup.
